risks.if_unproven: priced as used/unverified seal, worst case treated as non-airtight

risks.risk: Photos may show a sample drum while buyer receives a different, lower-quality one from a batch
risks.proof: Video or photo of the specific unit to be sold, with a visible marker/tag
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest-condition unit visible across the two photos

proof_requests: Close-up of any embossed capacity/volume marking on the drum body or base
Clear photo of the lid fully closed with the metal clamp latched, showing seal condition
Photo or statement of what the drum previously contained
